meta.title: Long-form Chinese Novel Workbench
meta.description: Attention-first workbench for long-form Chinese fiction: chapters, timeline, fact ledger, foreshadowing, conflicts, characters, highlights, reviews, proposals, plan alignment, world/location consistency, chapter map, full-book generation, 11 agent roles (incl. an attention designer and a zero-context fresh-read reviewer) and writing presets; AI generation and review built in.
